opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and draft the itinerary email
opportunities.description: For a given city, dates, party size, activities and cuisine: look up the city on Wikipedia and its weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a restaurant on OpenTable, save a summary note, then draft an email with the plan to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes app, mail app
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city}, open the city article and record the population
On timeanddate, search for {city}, open the Weather page and record the current temperature
On Booking.com, set the destination to {city}, pick check-in {start_date} and check-out {end_date}, set adults to {party_size}, click Search and open the top hotel (record its name and price)
On Viator, search for '{activity_1} {city}', open the top result; repeat for '{activity_2} {city}'
On OpenTable, search for '{city} {cuisine}', set the date to {start_date} and party size to {party_size}, click Find a table and open the top restaurant (record its name and 19:30 slot)
In Notes, add a note: '{city} {start}-{end}: pop X, T °C, hotel H €P, activity 1, activity 2, dinner R 19:30'
In Mail, write to {recipient_email} with subject '{city} weekend {start}-{end}' and a body summarizing the hotel, activities and dinner, then Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)
